main.description: A v2 publication pointer to exactly one plaintext snapshot payload, carried in one of two forms. The packed form is blob: the payload profile is vault Version 1 with CodecNone, canonical uncompressed USTAR and JSON manifest; the blob is the USTAR archive the packer emits (application/x-tar) and is limited to 402653184 bytes inclusive. The file-set form is entries: a set of individual files, each with its own file-level blob, for publications whose point is browsing the layout at the provider; file-set publications are opt-in per target, carry regular files only, and use paths of at most 1024 bytes that are relative, contain no empty, `.` or `..` segment, are unique within the record and appear in ascending order. Entry modes are limited to 0600 and 0644. A file-set publication carries at most 64 entries, the publication store's managed-object limit, so an opt-in target with more files than that cannot be published in file-set form. Settings, symlinks and directories use the packed form. Exactly one of blob or entries is present; a record carrying both or neither is invalid. Snapshot records use sequence keys of exactly 16 zero-padded ASCII decimal digits. Record CID and raw payload CID are distinct roles.
